Olympic Park will be very busy on Saturday and Sunday with around 80,000 Harry Styles fans expected each night, as well as 20,000 additional fans attending other events in the precinct across the weekend. 

Motorists should allow plenty of extra travel time on roads approaching Olympic Park including the M4 Mwy, Homebush Bay Dr, Concord Rd, Lane Cove Rd, Parramatta Rd, Centenary Dr and Silverwater Rd.

  • If you have pre-booked your parking, follow the directions of staff and have your parking ticket ready to show at the car park entry. If you haven't pre-booked parking don't drive to Olympic Park.

  • Alternatively, consider parking at a nearby train station commuter car park and continuing your trip by train to Olympic Park, at no extra cost.

Sydney Olympic Park Authority will close local roads in the precinct and traffic congestion is expected before and after the concert. For road closure details, visit the Sydney Olympic Park Authority interactive map.

No-parking zones will also be in effect from 6am to 10pm on sections of George St, Macquarie St, Park Ave, Pitt St, Queens Rd and Railway Pde. O'Connell St car park and Park Ave car park will also close from 6am, and the Parramatta Aquatic Centre car park will close from 8pm.

Road closures and special event clearways are in place for the City of Sydney - Christmas Fair on Glebe Point Rd. The event runs from midday until 8pm.

The following roads are closed from 7am Saturday 28 Nov to 1am Sunday 29 Nov

  • Glebe Point Rd between St Johns Rd and Broadway, and adjoining roads including sections of Cowper St, Derwent Ln, Derby Pl, Francis St, Mitchell St and Norton St.

Allow extra travel time, follow the directions of traffic control and be aware of increased pedestrian activity. Police may restrict vehicle access along closed roads, including residents and businesses.

Special event clearways are in effect from 7am until 11:30pm on sections of Glebe Point Rd, Francis St, Derby Pl, Cowper St, Norton St and Mitchell St.

Clearways are strict no-parking zones for all vehicle types and apply even to local residents and TfNSW Mobility Scheme Permit holders. Check signs carefully as vehicles left in clearways will be towed and a fee applies. If your vehicle is towed, you can search your vehicle registration at the Find My Car website to find its new location, or alternatively call 132 701 to speak to an operator.
